params.prompt: A wide calm sky just before sunrise. One thin luminous cyan horizon line, a few long soft glassy cloud bands, a faint perspective grid fading toward the horizon. Minimal and quiet, with lots of empty sky in the upper two thirds. No sun disc, no moon, no text, no letters, no numbers, no people, no animals, no buildings, no birds.
